entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the TrailGuard Pro helmet. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened, so it's brand new.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered about 54 days ago.

And that's perfectly fine. I'm checking our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied and that your safety gear is exactly what you want.
Fine. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
Whatever. About time something was simple.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
